sources.title: Law No. 88-025: conditions of foreigner stay in Comoros
sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice of the Union of the Comoros
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Justice Ministry legal-text portal publishes the foreigner-entry law. It subjects foreigners to treaty/special-law exceptions and separately specifies a transit visa issued at an airport or port and a 45-day tourist visa.
sources.supportingExcerpt: visa de transit ... délivré à l’aéroport ou au port

sources.title: Services aux étrangers
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of the Union of the Comoros
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry e-Government subsite identifies its foreigner-services catalogue but publishes no visa service, nationality schedule, or ordinary-passport arrival-issuance result.

sources.title: Comoros
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Singapore
sources.officialityEvidence: Singapore MFA's live Comoros page is government travel guidance for Singaporeans but supplies passport-validity advice and directs travellers to an embassy rather than giving a visa outcome or issuance location.
sources.supportingExcerpt: contact ... the nearest Embassy of Comoros

sources.title: Reisadvies Comoren
sources.officialityEvidence: The live NetherlandsWorldwide advice is a Ministry of Foreign Affairs result, last modified 13 May 2026 and still valid 25 August 2026. It identifies a Dutch passport's visa liability but only refers travellers to the Comorian Embassy.
sources.supportingExcerpt: U heeft een visum nodig ... met een Nederlands paspoort reist.

sources.title: Komori
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Republic of Slovenia
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Slovenian Foreign Ministry country page was last changed 24 April 2026 and says Slovenian citizens need a visa, but directs them to the Comorian Embassy in Paris without identifying tourist-visa issuance at an entry point.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Slovenski državljani potrebujejo vizum za vstop na Komore.

sources.title: Comorerne pas og visum
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Danish page says the Comoros authorities supplied its rule for Danish citizens, but the URL is explicitly archived and the page was last updated 5 March 2023; it is retained only as stale contrary route evidence.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visumpligt. Du kan søge om visum hos Comorernes ambassade.

sources.title: Brazil-Comoros mutual visa-exemption agreement
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Brazil
sources.officialityEvidence: Brazil's live treaty register records the agreement as in force from 19 December 2025, but its title limits mutual exemption to diplomatic, official and service passports rather than ordinary passports.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Passaportes Diplomático, Oficial e de Serviço
